sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At the heart of Poppy Stickman Battle Royale lies its core gameplay mechanics, which are designed to provide an engaging and challenging experience. The game's objective is to survive and outlast other players in a large-scale battle royale environment. Players are dropped onto a vast map, where they must scavenge for resources, craft gear, and engage in intense battles with other players and monsters.

One of the standout features of the game is its fighting mechanics. Players can use a variety of combat moves, including punches, kicks, and special abilities, to take down their opponents. The fighting mechanics are responsive and satisfying, making each battle feel intense and rewarding. Additionally, the game features a skill tree system, which allows players to upgrade their character's abilities and unlock new skills.

The game also features a crafting system, which enables players to craft new gear, ammunition, and other essential items. Players can gather resources from the environment, such as wood, stone, and metal, and use them to craft items that will aid them in their survival. The crafting system adds a new layer of depth to the game, as players must balance resource gathering with combat and exploration.

Overall, the game's core gameplay mechanics are designed to provide a thrilling and challenging experience. With its engaging fighting mechanics, skill tree system, and crafting system, Poppy Stickman Battle Royale offers a unique blend of action and strategy that will keep players hooked.
